description: A Claude Code sub-agent worktree copy (<project>/.claude/worktrees/agent-*) is not a project of its own, whether a session cwd, a Method A path or the state file names it: its memory file is not counted again, its state entry is reported as a sessionless `removed` project (so the Removed-projects acknowledgement can delete that one key, never the parent's), and each skipped copy is named in errors[]. Its session is attributed to the parent project, so no user turn is lost.

$contains:is not a project (its sessions and history count toward
